name: Galapagar (Spain)
description: Green field with a broad white band edged yellow from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Galapagar (green strewn with tortoises).
history: The arms of Galapagar were approved officially on 2 March 1978; the municipal flag, made official in 2015 and published on 21 August 2015, is a cloth of proportions 2:3, green, tierced per bend in white edged gold and charged with the municipal arms.
